hero.title: Run balanced adventures faster, without breaking the fantasy.
hero.description: A table-ready D&D toolkit for Dungeon Masters. Build encounters, scale monsters, and forge artifacts with outputs you can use immediately. Toggle 2014 or 2024 to swap the math underneath without changing your workflow.

exampleOutput.title: Example Encounter Output
exampleOutput.description: A concrete result, ready to run at the table. The tool surfaces a recommended mix and its budget fit.
exampleOutput.budgetExplanation: Budget Fit = adjusted XP / target XP. Example: 1,920 vs 2,000 XP → 96%.

sampleOutputs.title: Sample Outputs
sampleOutputs.description: Each tool produces a clear, table-ready result. Exports match the preview.
sampleOutputs.itemFlavor: "Forged at sunrise to turn the restless dead."

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.description: Three steps, built for live prep or mid-session pivots.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Encounter builder, monster scaler, or item forge.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Party size, difficulty, CR targets, and flavor details.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Copy the output or export PNG/PDF statblocks.

coreToolkit.title: Core Toolkit
coreToolkit.description: Concrete outputs for encounter building, scaling, and item design.

monsterScaler.title: Monster Scaler
monsterScaler.description: Adjust HP, AC, DPR, and suggested combat targets to a new CR. Includes export-ready statblocks.

encounterBuilder.title: Encounter Builder
encounterBuilder.description: Builds encounter budgets and enemy mixes from party size, level, and difficulty target.

artifactForge.title: Artifact Forge
artifactForge.description: Craft items with tuned bonuses, materials, and lore. Separates mechanical output from flavor text.

point1.title: Ruleset Coverage
point1.description: 2014 + 2024 guidance is supported so your encounter math stays consistent across editions.

point2.title: Export Ready
point2.description: Download PNG for VTT use or PDF for printouts. Filenames keep sessions organized.

point3.title: No Login Required
point3.description: Built for live sessions: fast inputs, readable outputs, and no account gate.

encounterBuilder.title: Encounter Builder
encounterBuilder.description: Create balanced encounters based on your party's level and size.
encounterBuilder.rulesetNote: 2014/2024 toggles threshold and per-CR XP tables.
encounterBuilder.budgetMath: Budget math: XP threshold × encounter multiplier. Ruleset choice changes thresholds and XP values.
encounterBuilder.exportSnapshot: Snapshot for quick screenshot or print.
encounterBuilder.calculationsNote: Calculations based on standard XP thresholds and encounter multipliers.

monsterScaler.title: Monster Scaler
monsterScaler.description: Scale HP, AC, DPR, and stat targets to a new CR while keeping the creature recognizable.
monsterScaler.whatScalesDesc: AC, HP, DPR targets, and ability modifiers.
monsterScaler.rulesetNotesDesc: 2014 uses DMG tables. 2024 uses updated bands with softened ranges.
monsterScaler.guardrailsDesc: Verify action economy, legendary actions, and unique traits after scaling.
monsterScaler.name: Name
monsterScaler.snapshotOutput: Snapshot of the exact export output.
monsterScaler.exportNote: PNG is optimized for VTT use. PDF is print-friendly. Files use the monster name for easy sorting. Outputs are advisory—review special actions and traits.

artifactForge.title: Artifact Forge
artifactForge.description: Craft items with balanced mechanical bonuses and a clear crafting story.
artifactForge.mechanicsNote: Mechanical bonuses are tuned by rarity band; adjust up or down to match your table's power curve.

artifactForge.lorePlaceholder: Short lore or legend behind the item.
artifactForge.name: Name
artifactForge.baselineNote: These suggestions provide a balanced baseline; adjust properties to fit your campaign's power level.
